items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Carney told me the same thing, he said they had terrible conduct.

ctx.x: That's what Smack told him that, you know? But they did that, you know, and they -- Carney told me the same thing, he said they had terrible conduct. He never had his full band.
They must have known that they were holding the band back.
